fusions.name: Gnawing Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses a cloud of gnawing wings 3 tiles ahead of you that deals 6 damage to everything in it. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Swarm Burst
fusions.desc: Sends a swarm into the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage, then bursts over every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Trailing Swarm
fusions.desc: Calls a swarm that runs with you for 18 seconds, gnawing an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, 3 stamina a second comes back to you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
